Select activity rows for target CHEMBL1075165. Join assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value. Return columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
